questions_choice_has_options.name: questions_choice_has_options
questions_choice_has_options.value: ("questions"."format" = 'choice') = ("questions"."options" IS NOT NULL AND "questions"."correct_option_index" IS NOT NULL)

student_links_account_matches_status.name: student_links_account_matches_status
student_links_account_matches_status.value:
("student_links"."status" = 'pending_connection' AND "student_links"."student_user_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("student_links"."status" IN ('pending_confirmation', 'active') AND "student_links"."student_user_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR "student_links"."status" = 'ended'

student_links_dates_match_status.name: student_links_dates_match_status
student_links_dates_match_status.value:
("student_links"."status" <> 'active' OR "student_links"."started_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND (("student_links"."status" = 'ended') = ("student_links"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL))
